name: video-frame-extractor
description: Frame-accurate video breakdowns: key frames with exact times, the script and shot list of a TikTok or ad, notes from lecture slides, and frames as JPG, PNG, ZIP or PDF.

interface.longDescription: Frame-accurate video breakdowns in ChatGPT. Attach a video and mention @Video Frame Extractor. The plugin turns the video into a compact package of key frames with exact times: one frame per scene or slide, every new window in a screen recording, every on-screen caption of a TikTok, Reels or ad read every half second. Use it to get the script and shot list of a short video for your own version, notes from lecture slides, the exact moment something appears, a fast movement frame by frame, or frames saved as JPG, PNG, ZIP or a PDF. Scene detection works for slides, screen recordings, phone video, fast edits and talking-head videos with graphics. Everything runs in ChatGPT's own code sandbox; nothing is uploaded anywhere else.
defaultPrompt: Break down this TikTok: script with times and a shot list for my product.
Notes from this lecture, one section per slide, with times.
Make a PDF with one frame for each slide of this video.
